title: Earth, Wind & Fire Radio: Listen to Their SiriusXM Channel
summary: Celebrate more than 50 years of Earth, Wind & Fire with their biggest hits, exclusive stories, and more all September long.
body_markdown:
Do you remember the 21st night of September? This September, celebrate more than 50 years of Earth, Wind & Fire with a new SiriusXM pop-up channel dedicated to the legendary group’s music and stories.


[Earth, Wind & Fire Radio The icons’ hits, stories & more Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogEarthWindFireRadio)


Earth, Wind & Fire Radio launches September 1 on the SiriusXM, featuring the nine-time GRAMMY Award winners’ genre-defying hits and anthems alongside exclusive stories and reflections from Philip Bailey, Verdine White, and Ralph Johnson.


### How to Listen to Earth, Wind & Fire Radio


Listen to Earth, Wind & Fire Radio on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogEarthWindFireRadio) throughout September. The channel will also be available on Ch. 51 in cars from September 21 through September 27.


SiriusXM app: September 1–30
Satellite radios: September 21–27 on Ch. 51


### What You’ll Hear


Earth, Wind & Fire Radio celebrates the group’s extraordinary career with the songs fans have known and loved for decades, from “September” and “Let’s Groove” to “Reasons” and more.


Throughout the month, Philip Bailey, Verdine White, and Ralph Johnson will also take listeners behind the music, moments, and milestones that shaped Earth, Wind & Fire’s remarkable journey and enduring influence across generations.

### About Earth, Wind & Fire


Founded by Maurice White in 1969, Earth, Wind & Fire have sold more than 100 million albums worldwide and scored eight No. 1 hits. The group has won nine GRAMMY Awards, including a Lifetime Achievement Award, and was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2000. In 2019, Earth, Wind & Fire received the prestigious Kennedy Center Honors for their contributions to American arts and culture.


From the infectious funk of “Let’s Groove” to the timeless “September” and heartfelt “Reasons,” Earth, Wind & Fire’s music continues to inspire new generations of listeners.
